principle: Every engineering concern is a first-class RAKL knowledge fiber with explicit scope, benchmark, authority boundary, tests, failure recovery, resource accounting and closure evidence.

scientific_closure_definition.allowed_claim: closed for a preregistered task/model/tool/evidence/budget scope
scientific_closure_definition.forbidden_claim: universally proven correct or complete for all future scientific tasks
minimum_requirements: matched baseline or ablation comparison where the component claims added value
independent/adversarial review where qualitative judgment affects authority

release_planes.closure_rule: no silent authority escalation or history loss
raw evidence reconstructable and summaries never replace authority-bearing source payloads
ordinary LLM receives bounded sufficient working set or explicit cannot-compile/cannot-check
candidate cannot authorize its own evaluation
clean-install end-to-end workflow reproducible on declared reference environments
paper claims bounded by executed evidence and explicit falsifiers

release_blocker: FRAMEWORK_FIBER_INVENTORY_019 reports all 24 registered high-impact method steps open or unbenchmarked; therefore no global scientific-closure claim is currently authorized.
